summary: One command to (re)start the demo API from main with the repo .env loaded

comments.body: PR #53 opened with scripts/start-api.ps1 implementation and env auto-loading. Verified idempotent restart and live Jira intake polling. Ready for review.

[claude] Done: PR #53 is merged (main 56550e9) after re-review.

* `scripts/start-api.ps1` + `scripts/run-api.cmd`: no secrets in any file (Python loads .env via python-dotenv), the demo token is required, and the readiness wait is 60 s.
* Non-blocking nits are left on the PR: the log path ignores `-LogFile`, and the `JIRA_*` alias line is unused.
